facts.text: The hotel is at the northeast corner of Nanjing Road East and Henan Road in Puxi, west of the Huangpu River.
facts.excerpt: located at the northeast corner of Nanjing Road East and Henan Road in Puxi, West of Huangpu River

facts.text: The hotel is a 5 minute walk from The Bund.
facts.excerpt: just a 5 minute walk from The Bund

facts.text: The hotel is made up of two separate towers.
facts.excerpt: is a unique combination of two separate towers

facts.text: YONE Restaurant & Bar is on the 27th floor and has signature triangular windows with views of the Bund and the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the 27th floor of The Shanghai EDITION, YONE Restaurant & Bar showcases panoramic views of the Bund and the city skyline through its signature triangular windows

facts.text: YONE takes rice as its inspiration, serving premium rice from regions across Japan and locally in a modern interpretation of Japanese cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Taking “rice” as its inspiration, YONE curates premium rice from regions across Japan and locally.

facts.text: YONE's signature cocktails are built on a sake foundation.
facts.excerpt: the signature cocktails are thoughtfully built upon a sake foundation

facts.text: Punch Room is a reservations-only bar modeled on London's 19th-century private clubs, enclosed by warm wooden vertical slats.
facts.excerpt: A modern reincarnation of London’s 19th-century private club, the reservations-only Punch Room

facts.text: Punch Room has close-up views of Pudong's skyscrapers.
facts.excerpt: close-up views of Pudong’s skyscrapers

facts.text: Roof is an open-air lounge on the 29th floor, surrounded by an ivy-covered trellis.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 29th floor and surrounded by a stunning ivy-covered trellis, ROOF is an open-air lounge area

facts.text: Shanghai Tavern offers all-day dining with a seasonal, contemporary European brasserie menu.
facts.excerpt: Shanghai Tavern offers all-day dining with a menu of seasonal, contemporary European brasserie.

facts.text: Shanghai Tavern's interior references layers of history behind the Shanghai Power Company Building.
facts.excerpt: The interior references layers of history behind the Shanghai Power Company Building

facts.text: Lobby Bar features bespoke plaster relief artwork inspired by carvings seen on Shikumen (stone-gated) housing.
facts.excerpt: bespoke plaster relief artwork inspired by carvings, typically observed on Shikumen (stone-gated) housing

facts.text: Club Room is on the 5th floor and is styled as an early 20th century private social club with a 9-seat bar and a screening room.
facts.excerpt: Designed in the style of an early 20th century private social club

facts.text: The roof has a landscaped English garden with an under-the-stars movie theatre and a games area for lawn bowling and croquet.
facts.excerpt: Roof Garden also features an under-the-stars movie theatre, a games area for lawn bowling and croquet

facts.text: The English garden on the roof mixes Chinese greenery with traditional English horticulture.
facts.excerpt: Mixing Chinese greenery with traditional English horticulture

facts.text: The private pool area overlooks Nanjing Road and is enclosed in a conservatory designed to bathe the area in natural light.
facts.excerpt: The Private pool area, overlooking Nanjing Road, is enclosed in a conservatory designed to bathe the area in natural light.

facts.text: The pool area has a main pool and a thermally engineered hot tub.
facts.excerpt: The elegant space offers a main pool as well as a thermally engineered hot tub.

facts.text: The spa has six treatment rooms and a spacious relaxation zone.
facts.excerpt: The spa features six treatment rooms, along with a sauna changing area and a spacious relaxation zone.

facts.text: The gym is on level 7 and is open 24 hours, with a large outdoor terrace for tai chi, yoga or cardio.
facts.excerpt: The 24-hour facility features a large outdoor terrace where guest can relax, practice tai chi, yoga, or cardio

facts.text: The hotel has a Penthouse that takes up the entire 25th floor.
facts.excerpt: One-of-a-kind Penthouse comprised of the entire 25th floor

facts.text: Some rooms and suites have oversized furnished terraces.
facts.excerpt: 145 unique rooms and suites, some with oversized furnished terraces

facts.text: Suites have an open plan living and dining area, walk-in wardrobes and large angled windows.
facts.excerpt: Suites feature an open plan living and dining area, light-filled bedrooms, walk-in-wardrobes, large angled windows

facts.text: Rooms have views of the historical Bund area against the backdrop of Pudong's skyscrapers.
facts.excerpt: views of the historical Bund area of Shanghai Puxi, against the backdrop of Pudong’s modern skyscrapers

facts.text: The hotel offers 24-hour room service and valet parking.
facts.excerpt: 24-hour Room Service
